blobs_ready_verified_check.name: blobs_ready_verified_check
blobs_ready_verified_check.value: "blobs"."state" <> 'ready' or ("blobs"."verified_at" is not null and "blobs"."detected_mime" is not null)

chart_reports_resolution_check.name: chart_reports_resolution_check
chart_reports_resolution_check.value: ("chart_reports"."status"='open' and "chart_reports"."resolved_at" is null and "chart_reports"."resolution_note" is null and "chart_reports"."resolver_public_id" is null) or ("chart_reports"."status"<>'open' and "chart_reports"."resolved_at" is not null and char_length("chart_reports"."resolution_note") between 1 and 500 and "chart_reports"."resolution_note" is not null and "chart_reports"."resolver_public_id">0 and "chart_reports"."resolver_public_id" is not null)

chart_versions_live_source_check.name: chart_versions_live_source_check
chart_versions_live_source_check.value: "chart_versions"."deleted_at" is not null or "chart_versions"."source_file_id" is not null

charts_metadata_length_check.name: charts_metadata_length_check
charts_metadata_length_check.value: char_length("charts"."description") <= 2000 and char_length("charts"."credits") <= 1000 and jsonb_typeof("charts"."tags")='array' and jsonb_array_length("charts"."tags") <= 8

community_follows_valid.name: community_follows_valid
community_follows_valid.value: "community_follows"."user_id"<>"community_follows"."author_id" and "community_follows"."revision">0 and "community_follows"."journal_sequence">0 and ("community_follows"."notify_since" is null or ("community_follows"."followed_at" is not null and "community_follows"."notify_since">="community_follows"."followed_at"))

discussion_messages_context.name: discussion_messages_context
discussion_messages_context.value: ("discussion_messages"."topic_id" is not null and "discussion_messages"."chart_id" is null and "discussion_messages"."version_id" is null and "discussion_messages"."root_id" is null and "discussion_messages"."difficulty" is null and "discussion_messages"."timestamp_ms" is null) or ("discussion_messages"."topic_id" is null and "discussion_messages"."chart_id" is not null and "discussion_messages"."version_id" is not null)

discussion_messages_time.name: discussion_messages_time
discussion_messages_time.value: ("discussion_messages"."difficulty" is null or "discussion_messages"."difficulty" between 1 and 7) and ("discussion_messages"."timestamp_ms" is null or ("discussion_messages"."difficulty" is not null and "discussion_messages"."timestamp_ms">=0))

files_name_check.name: files_name_check
files_name_check.value: char_length("files"."original_name") between 1 and 255 and "files"."original_name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]/]' and position(chr(92) in "files"."original_name") = 0 and "files"."original_name" not in ('.','..')

storage_backup_status_counts_check.name: storage_backup_status_counts_check
storage_backup_status_counts_check.value: ("storage_backup_status"."original_count" is null or "storage_backup_status"."original_count" >= 0) and ("storage_backup_status"."bytes" is null or "storage_backup_status"."bytes" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

storage_journal_progress_checkpoint_chec.name: storage_journal_progress_checkpoint_check
storage_journal_progress_checkpoint_chec.value: ("storage_journal_progress"."exported_sequence" = 0 and "storage_journal_progress"."chain_hash" is null and "storage_journal_progress"."exported_at" is null) or ("storage_journal_progress"."exported_sequence" > 0 and "storage_journal_progress"."chain_hash" is not null and "storage_journal_progress"."exported_at" is not null)

storage_quarantine_delete_check.name: storage_quarantine_delete_check
storage_quarantine_delete_check.value: (not "storage_quarantine"."delete_uncertain" or "storage_quarantine"."delete_started_at" is not null) and ("storage_quarantine"."state"<>'deleted' or ("storage_quarantine"."delete_started_at" is not null and not "storage_quarantine"."delete_uncertain"))

storage_runtime_roles_check.name: storage_runtime_roles_check
storage_runtime_roles_check.value: "storage_runtime_roles"."acknowledged_at" is null or "storage_runtime_roles"."pause_owner" is not null

storage_tombstones_subject_check.name: storage_tombstones_subject_check
storage_tombstones_subject_check.value: ("storage_tombstones"."kind" = 'private_social' and "storage_tombstones"."payload" is not null) or ("storage_tombstones"."kind" = 'community_content' and "storage_tombstones"."payload" is not null) or ("storage_tombstones"."kind" = 'user_public_id' and "storage_tombstones"."user_id" is not null and "storage_tombstones"."payload" is not null) or ("storage_tombstones"."kind" = 'chart_permission' and "storage_tombstones"."payload" is not null) or ("storage_tombstones"."kind" = 'user_deleted' and "storage_tombstones"."user_id" is not null) or ("storage_tombstones"."kind" = 'file_deleted' and "storage_tombstones"."file_id" is not null) or ("storage_tombstones"."kind" in ('hash_blocked','media_revoked') and "storage_tombstones"."sha256" is not null)

upload_sessions_name_check.name: upload_sessions_name_check
upload_sessions_name_check.value: char_length("upload_sessions"."original_name") between 1 and 255 and "upload_sessions"."original_name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]/]' and position(chr(92) in "upload_sessions"."original_name") = 0 and "upload_sessions"."original_name" not in ('.','..')
